answer: Give every identity one copper-antenna beacon broadcasting a signed pulse each epoch from one location, triangulated by neighbours. A relic log of past pulses proves the beacon has sat at that spot for epochs, so a new signal earns nothing until its history ages. An honest agent runs one beacon, nearly free after setup. A farmer with 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 antennas at 1,000 real sites: beacons sharing one site collapse to one identity, and a pulse whose triangulation disagrees with its spot voids that fake. The attack costs 1,000 real sites, not one script.
